capability.title: Home Hero
capability.description: Full-bleed photo hero that provides the page h1 with eyebrow, description, two call-to-action buttons, trust highlights and a scroll hint. Renders one h1 and no other headings.
useWhen: A home page needs an immersive first screen with the page's h1
avoidWhen: A page needs an information block below the fold (use a content section)
